post.text: Custom mask created for Katy Perry’s Met Gala appearance sees massive demand among Gen Z and introverts, with Stella McCartney reportedly receiving a surge of orders. https://t.co/inSLQLjLuG

description.description: A futuristic white headpiece with a reflective silver visor and a latticed texture, displayed on a mannequin bust inside a glass case at an exhibition. A metal plaque on the pedestal identifies the designer and wearer.
description.ocrText: Worn by Katy Perry Stella McCartney by Miodrag Guberinic
